concerns.text: The plan uses asymptotic normal confidence intervals for N ≥ 1000 and a 200‑resample bootstrap for N < 1000 (see ‘Confidence intervals: asymptotic normal for N ≥ 1000; bootstrap (200 resamples) default for N < 1000’). Under model misspecification the AIPW estimator can exhibit non‑regular asymptotics, making the normal approximation unreliable and a 200‑resample bootstrap potentially insufficient for accurate 95 % coverage. This threatens the validity of SC‑003 (empirical coverage) and may lead to misleading conclusions about the double‑robust property.
